key_path: Sign up at elevenlabs.io/app/sign-up (email+password or Google/Apple OAuth)
Free plan active immediately (10k credits/month, no card)
Settings > API keys > Create (optional endpoint scope, credit quota, IP allowlist, expiry)
OR skip the key: connect https://api.elevenlabs.io/v1/mcp with OAuth, or run `elevenlabs auth login`

agent_native_auth.cli_login_browser_or_device: yes. `elevenlabs auth login` does browser OAuth and stores the token in the OS keyring
agent_native_auth.oauth_dynamic_client_registration: partial. The hosted MCP uses OAuth with a Client ID Metadata Document (client_id_metadata_document_supported=true). No registration_endpoint, so no classic RFC 7591 DCR. Protected-resource metadata exposes scopes: convai_read/write, text_to_speech, speech_history_read, flows, image_video_generation, voice_generation
agent_native_auth.provisioning_api_mints_keys: yes. Service Accounts API: create a service account, then POST its API keys; there is also an API to disable keys
agent_native_auth.scoped_keys: yes. Endpoint scope restriction, per-key credit quota, IP allowlist, 15-minute to 30-day expiry

product_mcp.auth: OAuth (CIMD), workspace selection and scoped consent

mcp.local_package: uvx elevenlabs-mcp, DEPRECATED (repo archived) in favor of the hosted server
mcp.one_click_install: listed in the Claude Desktop connector directory (one-click Connect). elevenlabs/plugin bundles the MCP and skills for Cursor, Claude Code and Codex

docs_for_agents.llms_txt: https://elevenlabs.io/docs/llms.txt (with an 'Instructions for AI Agents' header and per-section llms.txt)
docs_for_agents.agents_md_or_rules: elevenlabs/skills plus the plugin, including a 'setup-api-key' skill

score_justification: Free tier with no card, a hosted OAuth MCP in the Claude directory, CLI OAuth, a key-minting API with scoped and quota-capped keys, and full llms/OpenAPI coverage.
best_practice: The hosted MCP uses OAuth and scoped consent, so 'no API keys are copied into the client'. They also retired the local key-based server in its favor.
biggest_gap: OAuth relies on CIMD only (no DCR), so clients without CIMD support need a key. Email verification is still a human step for email signups.
notes_out_of_date: GitHub and Facebook sign-in were removed. The local elevenlabs-mcp repo is archived.
